product_overview: IAMS is an Internal Audit Management System for managing audit work end-to-end, including login, dashboards, audit planning, findings, evidence, recommendations, risks, correspondence, compliance tracking, and reporting. The product also supports Arabic/English language switching and user preference settings.
core_goals: Authenticate into the system and access the main dashboard
Create, review, update, filter, and delete audit plans and findings
Track risks, recommendations, evidence, correspondence, notifications, and compliance items
Manage departments, organizational structure, and user/admin data

features.name: User Login
features.description: Allows users to sign in with username/email and password, with optional remember-me and language switching on the login screen. The flow also supports forced password change and 2FA when prompted.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill in username or email -> Fill in password -> Optionally enable remember me -> Submit login form -> See dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Switch the interface language -> Fill in username or email -> Fill in password -> Submit login form -> See the next authentication step or dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Fill in username or email -> Fill in password -> Submit login form -> Enter 2FA code when prompted -> See dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Fill in username or email -> Fill in password -> Submit login form -> Change password when prompted -> See dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Fill in username or email -> Fill in password -> Submit login form -> See an invalid credentials message

features.name: Dashboard
features.description: Shows audit analytics, overview widgets, and summary charts for current audit activity, with navigation into other areas of the system.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> View audit statistics cards -> View charts and graphs -> Navigate to a related module from the dashboard

features.name: Audit Plans
features.description: Lets users create and manage audit plans, review details, filter lists, edit records, and delete plans.
user_flows: Navigate to /plan -> View the audit plan list -> Create a new audit plan -> Save the plan -> See it appear in the list
Navigate to /plan -> View the audit plan list -> Filter by status or department -> Review the matching plans
Navigate to /plan -> View the audit plan list -> Open a plan's details -> Edit the plan information -> Save changes -> See the updated plan
Navigate to /plan -> View the audit plan list -> Delete an audit plan -> See the plan removed from the list

features.name: Audit Findings
features.description: Supports creating and maintaining audit findings, including risk level tracking and status-based filtering.
user_flows: Navigate to /findings -> View the findings list -> Create a new finding -> Save the finding -> See it appear in the list
Navigate to /findings -> View the findings list -> Filter by status or risk level -> Review the matching findings
Navigate to /findings -> View the findings list -> Open a finding -> Edit the finding details -> Save changes -> See the updated finding
Navigate to /findings -> View the findings list -> Delete a finding -> See the finding removed from the list

features.name: Risk Register
features.description: Provides a register for organizational risks with scoring, mitigation tracking, and status-based filtering.
user_flows: Navigate to /risks -> View the risk register table -> Add a new risk item -> Save the risk -> See it appear in the table
Navigate to /risks -> View the risk register table -> Filter by status or rating -> Review the matching risks
Navigate to /risks -> View the risk register table -> Open a risk item -> Edit the risk details -> Save changes -> See the updated risk item
Navigate to /risks -> View the risk register table -> Delete a risk item -> See the risk removed from the table

features.name: Correspondence Management
features.description: Manages incoming and outgoing official correspondence with classification, follow-up, filtering, editing, and deletion.
user_flows: Navigate to /cms -> View the correspondence list -> Create incoming correspondence -> Save it -> See it appear in the list
Navigate to /cms -> View the correspondence list -> Create outgoing correspondence -> Save it -> See it appear in the list
Navigate to /cms -> View the correspondence list -> Filter by type, status, or classification -> Review the matching correspondence
Navigate to /cms -> View the correspondence list -> Open a correspondence item -> Edit its details -> Save changes -> See the updated item
Navigate to /cms -> View the correspondence list -> Delete a correspondence item -> See it removed from the list

features.name: User Management
features.description: Lets administrators manage users, including creating accounts, editing permissions, disabling or enabling access, filtering, and deleting users.
user_flows: Navigate to /users -> View the user list -> Create a new user -> Save the user -> See the user appear in the list
Navigate to /users -> View the user list -> Filter by role or status -> Review the matching users
Navigate to /users -> View the user list -> Open a user record -> Edit user details and permissions -> Save changes -> See the updated user
Navigate to /users -> View the user list -> Disable a user -> See the user's status change
Navigate to /users -> View the user list -> Enable a disabled user -> See the user's status change
Navigate to /users -> View the user list -> Delete a user -> See the user removed from the list

features.name: Department Management
features.description: Supports viewing and maintaining organizational departments, including hierarchy, job titles, and unit assignments.
user_flows: Navigate to /departments -> View the department tree or list -> Create a new department -> Save the department -> See it appear in the hierarchy
Navigate to /departments -> View the department tree or list -> Open a department -> Edit department details -> Save changes -> See the updated department
Navigate to /departments -> View the department tree or list -> Manage job titles within a department -> Save changes -> See the updated structure
Navigate to /departments -> View the department tree or list -> Delete a department -> See the department removed from the list

features.name: Notifications
features.description: Displays user notifications and allows users to mark items as read or open related records.
user_flows: Navigate to /notifications -> View the notification list -> Open a notification to navigate to the related item
Navigate to /notifications -> View the notification list -> Mark a notification as read -> See the notification update in the list

features.name: Settings
features.description: Allows users to update personal preferences such as theme, language, and display options.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings -> Toggle between dark and light theme -> See the interface update
Navigate to /settings -> Switch the language between Arabic and English -> See the interface language update
Navigate to /settings -> Update display preferences -> Save the preference changes -> See the updated settings

features.name: Compliance Matrix
features.description: Provides a grid for tracking compliance items, viewing compliance status, adding items, editing status, and linking compliance entries to audit plans.
user_flows: Navigate to /compliance-matrix -> View the compliance matrix grid -> Add a compliance item -> Save it -> See it appear in the matrix
Navigate to /compliance-matrix -> View the compliance matrix grid -> Edit a compliance status -> Save changes -> See the updated status in the matrix
Navigate to /compliance-matrix -> View the compliance matrix grid -> Link a compliance item to an audit plan -> See the relationship reflected in the matrix

features.name: Reports
features.description: Supports selecting a report type, configuring parameters, generating reports, and downloading exports.
user_flows: Navigate to /reports -> Select a report type -> Configure the report parameters -> Generate the report -> Download the output
Navigate to /reports -> Select a report type -> Configure the report parameters -> Generate the report -> Export the report in the available format

Audit program library with reusable templates
